result.question: What happens when Gaal fights Abimelech?

readings.answer: Abimelech pursues him, Gaal flees, and many Shechemites are wounded.
readings.support: but Abimelech pursued him, and Gaal fled before him. And many Shechemites fell wounded all the way to the entrance of the gate.

assessments.reason: It accurately states that Abimelech pursues, Gaal flees, and many Shechemites are wounded per v40; the only difference is saying “wounded” rather than the key’s “die,” which is a weaker but text-supported outcome of the same event.
